posture: 171 roles listed in the last 7 days - 51 strong-act - 26 interim, contract or fixed-term leads - 6 board and NED seats. Afternoon refresh: all 169 roles carried in from the midday run were re-opened in Chrome and every one still resolved to a live posting, 11 were dropped for failing the Sydney-only rule and 1 aged out of the 7-day window, and 14 newly listed Chrome-verified roles were added. summary: Afternoon refresh of the Monday digest, covering roles listed between 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-31. Every one of the 169 roles carried in from the midday run was re-opened in Chrome this run and all were still live, but a location audit removed 11 listings based outside Sydney metro (Adelaide, Melbourne, Ballarat, Hobart, Darwin, Springfield and Bunbury) that the Sydney-only rule in the spec excludes, and 1 aged out of the seven-day window. 14 newly listed Chrome-verified roles were added, led by a Senior Manager Risk fixed term and a Risk Manager contract at Sydney Metro, and a newly created Deputy CEO and Company Secretary post at Road Trauma Support Group Australia. Browser-verified this run: Seek (full query battery via rendered job pages), I Work for NSW, Sharp & Carter, Bluefin Resources, Board Direction, EthicalJobs and Robert Half. Board Direction's NSW vacancies and the AICD Directorship Opportunities platform are now fully login-gated with no public teasers, so nothing from either could be logged; Robert Half's job pages would not render their content, so its two on-target Sydney roles (a Financial Controller and a Finance Director) could not be date-checked and were left out - both are worth a manual look. Coverage is a sample, not a census, so a manual sweep of the specialist recruiters remains worthwhile - and the standing note holds: the interim desks at Bluefin, Kaizen, JS Careers, KPP, Robert Half and Sharp & Carter fill day-rate work from candidates already registered with a current CV.
